# The Institutional Will — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-80430
Voiceover: An accession-quality record preserves a house object beyond the founder’s lifetime while keeping the object, maker attribution, and museum stewardship distinct.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of James A. and Mary Elizabeth Kingsland, 1994

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CN12-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · INTENT — What should happen—and why?. Write desired outcomes for company, name, work in progress, archive, public voice, teaching, licensing, philanthropy, privacy, dependents, and closure in plain language.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CN12-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · AUTHORITY — Which instrument can make it happen?. Map corporate documents, contracts, employment terms, IP records, wills or trusts, powers, beneficiary designations, data policies, archive agreements, and jurisdiction-specific requirements with counsel.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CN12-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · STEWARD — Who acts, who substitutes, who reviews?. Name primary and alternate decision-makers by function; address conflicts, expertise, compensation, access, accountability, dissent, cultural authority, and removal.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CN12-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · REHEARSE — Does the plan work in practice?. Run incapacity, death, departure, sale, closure, dispute, data loss, platform failure, preservation emergency, and public controversy; record fixes and review dates.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
